newsitem.title: USA: SoCal Edison power lines running normally.
newsitem.headline: SoCal Edison power lines running normally.

text.p: Southern California Edison Co, a unit of Edison International, said major power lines that were down earlier this week because of wildfires are back to scheduled operations.
"The fire is a bit more controlled," said Edison spokesman Steve Conroy. "We expect normal operations over the weekend."

Two of the utility's three 220-kilovolt lines in southern California resumed service on Thursday night after being shut late on Wednesday. Two of Edison's three 500-KV lines running to the Pacific Northwest were also shut early this week due to smoke contamination, but they were back up by late Tuesday.
